small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 33% — split the inner IC loop into chunks and accumulate, drop BLOCK_OC to 16 or BLOCK_SP to 64 so registers/thread fall below 64. Add @triton.autotune over (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SP, num_warps, num_stages) ∈ {(16,128,4,2),(32,64,4,2),(16,64,4,3),(64,32,8,2)} keyed on (OC, OD*OH*OW, IC*KD*KH*KW). Also fuse the BN+mean-subtract path so it runs unconditionally (current eval-path fusion is dead under training=True).
large_guidance: Rewrite the ConvTranspose3d as an im2col-style GEMM where each program computes a (BLOCK_M output-spatial × BLOCK_N OC) tile by iterating GEMM-K over (IC*KD*KH*KW) with tl.dot, using channels_last layout so the K axis is contiguous. Handle stride/padding via gather-index math on the output side (input pos = (out+pad-k)/stride with divisibility mask), and fuse the BN affine (folded scale/shift from running stats) plus per-(N,C) mean subtraction into the epilogue via a two-pass scheme or a follow-up fused reduction kernel that runs on the training path too (don't gate on bn.training).
